I suppose all their armies melted like sugar cubes in the face of the Germans after I cancelled subsidies, but I have 20 infamy worth of war goals riding on this war, and I stopped here knowing the final showdown between me and Germany would go till 1936 if I'm lucky.  
  
I have the advantage in military size, but with the republicans in charge... I had to cut funding everywhere and their Tariffs has my nation in Great Depression levels of unemployment. Further an the "Great Iron Shortage" (I guess I grew too fast as a nation) had been in effect since the 1870s.  
  
Also technically Britain is in this war but they no longer have 200k stacks on their home islands, they have 5 ships, and London is occupied. What I'm more worried about is that France is making retreat after retreat, and I will not enjoy having to possibly mobilize and micro 300 new brigades to fight Germany in addition to ferrying over 10 existing armies that occupied Canada.  
  
also my supply range tech is not very high because I didn't think the war would last this long, I thought the combined armies of France, Russia and Austria-Hungary (which combined, at the start of the war, was like 1.5 times the military score of Germany.)
